localidad: Santuario de fauna y flora los Colorados, San Juán Nepomuceno, Bolívar
comentarios: A large flock about 8 individuals flying over canopy of dry forest in forest interior. They were seen feeding of Hura crepitans fruits and doing short flies between fruiting trees in small sub grups of 3 individuals. Recording distance was 50 meters. They were recorded in a conserved tract of dry forest in SFF los Colorados, a colombian protected area that harbors one of most extensive remnants of dry forest in "montes de maria" zone in northern carib region. Previously labeled as  XC382454 in the collection.
